explanation: Binding fix: the runner indexes object-literal methods by their dotted declaration path, so the earlier bracket form APP.actions['submit-review'] matched nothing; the action is now bound as APP.actions.submit-review. Substance: REQ-6-5 says an eligible PR - targets protected main, has a current non-author approval, test: success, no conflicts - must be mergeable and its Merge pull request control must not report an unmet condition. The app's own review flow stores the decision text 'Approved' (the value REQ-6-3-4 says the page shows for Approve), but the merge gate mergeBlockers only counts reviews whose status is exactly 'Approve', so the approval is invisible, 'Review required by branch protection' is reported and the only Merge pull request button stays disabled. The fixture is valid and uses the real transition rather than hand-written review records: alice-dev (u1) is Owner of org1 and therefore Admin on the seeded public repository acme-docs (r1), is not the author of seeded PR p1 (author 'alice'), main carries seeded protection rule bp1 with both toggles enabled, and the PR's test check is set to success.

explanation: Binding fix: the review action is bound by its dotted declaration path APP.actions.submit-review (the earlier bracket form matched no source binding). Substance: REQ-6-5 requires that merging finds 'no valid Request changes', and REQ-6-3-4 requires Request changes to block merging for the current compare commit. The app's own review flow records this decision with the displayed status text 'Changes requested', but mergeBlockers only looks for reviews whose status is exactly 'Request changes', so the blocking decision is never seen and the Merge pull request button stays enabled. The fixture isolates that rule: acme-docs r1 branch release is unprotected, so no approval-count or check condition can mask the defect; the fixture PR uses the real seeded topology (onboarding is genuinely ahead of release at c2) and a non-author reviewer with Admin permission who has no prior decision on the PR, so the control in the precondition (no blocker before the review) holds.

explanation: Binding fix: the removal handler is bound by its dotted declaration path APP.actions.confirm-remove-member instead of the bracket notation, which matched no source binding. Substance: REQ-2-2-4 and REQ-2-2 require that a removal which would leave the organization with no Owner is rejected and keeps all relationships unchanged ('the last Owner must not be removed'). Seeded org1 has exactly one Owner membership, alice-dev (u1), so removing that member must leave memberships, team memberships and repository grants untouched; confirm-remove-member applies the deletion unconditionally and leaves the organization without any Owner. The fixture is valid: u1 is the sole Owner, u2 and others remain ordinary members, and the handler is invoked with the organization route context the People page supplies.
